description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeavePeriodAPI class, specifically testing the 'getOne', 'getAll', validation rules, and update functionality within the Leave API module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the LeavePeriodAPI's functionality, including tests for retrieving leave periods, validation, and updating leave period data.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single leave period, mocking service responses and validating normalization and metadata outputs.

methods.name: testGetOneLeavePeriodUndefined
methods.description: Tests the scenario when no leave period is defined, ensuring proper defaults and metadata states.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the 'getOne' method, including successful validation and expected exceptions for invalid input.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of leave periods, including proper normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Runs parameterized tests for updating leave period data, utilizing fixtures and mock services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides data sets for data-driven testing of the update method.
